name: Boxes PRO overbought box (BUY)
note: Author flags an exhaustion 'box' and fires BUY when both a fast (21) and slow (112) lookback Williams %R sit in the overbought zone together for a couple of bars.  SIMPLIFIED: Ignored EMA smoothing applied to fast %R (7) and slow %R (3) before the threshold check; Collapsed the entry state machine (strict entry threshold -20, looser hysteresis exit threshold -35, grace bars before closing, min-bars-to-confirm) into a single above(-20) condition held for 2 bars; Dropped the optional trend filter (EMA) and min-box-height ATR filter, both off by default in the script; Dropped the mirrored SELL/ov
